answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farms. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities; each pick must solve a cipher puzzle in 90s, proving compute behind the key. A sybil farm is karst: one surface, hidden tunnels, a thousand keys, few machines, checked fakes time out and lose a $30 bond locked 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000; one honest agent pays $30 once and earns $14 per epoch in the harbor.
